title: The Story of Who Moved My Cheese?
coreMove: When Cheese moves, stop arguing with the empty station, read the early signs, take one scouting step toward New Cheese, and keep your shoes ready.

exampleSpecs.audience: operations leaders facing a vanished supply route
exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid spending the shift defending a dead route
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist follows evidence away from the old station

exampleSpecs.audience: customer teams whose old renewal script stopped working
exampleSpecs.stakes: separate shock from a useful search
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist refuses to make fairness the whole meeting

exampleSpecs.audience: care coordinators mistaking effort for movement
exampleSpecs.stakes: free staff from labor aimed at a dead process
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist distinguishes visible effort from useful motion
the protagonist turns a change lesson into a visible trail

exampleSpecs.audience: event producers after a successful pivot
exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid treating the new win as permanent property
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist keeps scouting after the replacement works
